claim: Modeling through prediction and measurement: analysis informs implementation; measured discrepancies direct investigation and iterative model refinement. Values are illustrative; an acceptable residual addresses the selected prediction, not all system obligations.
topology: (a) Problem → Model → Analyze → Prediction / design → Implementation → Measurement → Explain residual, returning to Model via refine model. (b) Model predicts 11.5 s → Observed 17.8 s → Residual: +6.3 s, branching to Wrong parameter, Wrong relation and Missing mechanism. (c) Update the model → Reanalyze (e.g., new prediction) → Implement change → Measure again → Residual acceptable? Yes leads to Keep the change; No returns to Update the model.
bw_encoding: Three pale gray heading bands separate panels. Residual has 8% gray emphasis and the acceptance diamond 5%; ordinary action boxes remain white. Black directed edges and the decision diamond preserve meaning independently of shade.
